title: The operator's decision a call carries in _meta.decision (fabric-actions/0.1, DEC-0121 AP-2)
description: The operator's decision on a relayed action, carried by a T0 or T1 caller in its request's _meta.decision. by is always operator: an agent sets it only for an instruction the operator gave in its own session (AP-3). via relayed-instruction: the agent passes on what the operator told it, quoting the operator's words in instruction. via elicitation: the person accepted the service's own elicitation in their client. A service also reads at strictly (RFC 3339 with T and an offset, a day that exists; src/rfc3339.ts strictTime) and answers decision-invalid otherwise. docs/specification/service.md#actions.

instruction.description: The operator's words, verbatim; required with via relayed-instruction.

relayedBy.description: The agent that relays the decision, as the service records it.
